mentions.name: Concave split ergonomic keyboard
mentions.description: A concave split ergonomic keyboard launching June 2nd, similar to the Kinesis Advantage but smaller and more compact. It features a downward-angled thumb cluster that uses thumb abduction for a more ergonomic handshake position, layer keys offset at a lower height to avoid accidental presses, and is QMK compatible and hotswappable. DFM is complete so it is ready for injection molding, with a planned clinical study to develop it into a medical device for wrist pain treatment after several years of iteration with over 120 users.
mentions.problem: Typing setups cause wrist pain, and existing concave keyboards like the Kinesis Advantage are bulky with hard-to-reach thumb clusters.
mentions.audience: People with wrist pain (planned medical-device use case)
mentions.source_excerpt: I'm a doctor who built a concave split ergonomic keyboard I'm launching June 2nd. DFM is finally done so everything is ready for injection molding. Plan is to do a clinical study on it afterwards and turn it into a medical device for wrist pain treatment.

mentions.name: TAIKO-01
mentions.description: A split concave ergonomic keyboard designed by a physician for treatment of hand and wrist repetitive strain injury, which the maker is working to register as a medical device. Design for manufacturing is being finalized, injection mold prototypes are pending, a Kickstarter launch is planned within a few months, and a clinical study awaiting ethics approval will follow the launch after promising user-testing results.
mentions.problem: The maker previously suffered wrist tendinosis and carpal tunnel, and the keyboard aims to treat hand/wrist repetitive strain injury.
mentions.audience: People with hand or wrist repetitive strain injury

mentions.description: A concave split ergonomic keyboard aimed at hand/wrist RSI, with a clinical trial planned for it. Release was originally targeted for January but is delayed until around March, and ethics board approval is pending for a preclinical trial once it is ready.

Was originally planning on releasing it in Jan but it's getting delayed until sometime in March. Concurrently waiting on ethics board approval to run a preclinical trail for when it's ready.
